items.title: The glass cliff in college sports
items.question: Are coaches from underrepresented groups more often hired into struggling programs, and how does that shape their careers?
items.methods: Archival data on 1,200+ NCAA Division I coaches across 20 sports and 25+ years; longitudinal modeling of performance and turnover across 300+ programs.

items.title: Teaching teamwork through film
items.question: Does a video-based HR curriculum improve students' teamwork skills?
items.methods: Pre and post surveys of 62 students across 12 teamwork competency measures.
items.findings: All 12 measures improved significantly (p < .001). I wrote the full report, including the literature review and recommendations.

items.title: Budget barriers for student organizations
items.role: Policy and Student Relations Specialist, CEPA
items.question: What stops student organizations from getting and using the funding they need?
items.methods: Interviews with 10 to 15 registered student organizations; mapping barriers that affect 10,000+ students.
items.findings: Findings were published as an open letter to campus decision-makers.

items.title: How students win policy change
items.question: What strategies help students frame issues, use data and move decision-makers?
items.methods: Case research on student activism at UMass, turned into workshops and toolkits.
